harness: Run npm run test:evals, test:import, test:hubspot. Invalid cases must return 4xx with plain error strings. Gmail send only after approve. No LinkedIn API. No Lemlist.

valid_cases.scenario: Generate three corporate law demo sample leads (fallback)
valid_cases.request: POST /api/leads { action: generate, count: 3, practiceArea: Corporate / M&A, minScore: 80 }
expectations: Each lead has practiceArea containing Corporate
Response 200 with draft.body containing firm name

valid_cases.scenario: Book demo with valid AE on per-AE calendar link
valid_cases.request: POST /api/bookings { leadId: lead_8, aeName: Sarah Chen, scheduledAt: future ISO, durationMinutes: 30 }
expectations: Response 200 with booking.meetingLink matching AE calendar URL pattern

valid_cases.scenario: Preview Sales Nav CSV with default NL+BE geo filter
valid_cases.request: POST /api/leads { action: import_preview, csvText: <fixture>, geoFilter: [BE, NL], minScore: 70 }
expectations: Response 200 with preview.rows length matching fixture
BE and NL lawyer rows pass filter; non-NL/BE rows filtered out
Column mapping auto-detects First Name / Company / LinkedIn URL aliases

valid_cases.scenario: Commit selected Sales Nav rows after human review
valid_cases.request: POST /api/leads { action: import_commit, rows: [one BE lawyer] }

valid_cases.scenario: Deduplicate import by email or LinkedIn URL
valid_cases.request: POST import_commit with email matching existing workspace lead
expectations: Workspace lead count does not double for same email

valid_cases.scenario: HubSpot sync in mock mode without token (company notes)
valid_cases.request: POST /api/hubspot { action: sync } with HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN unset
expectations: upserted leads include CRM whyGood/opener from company notes/props
strong social presence leads flagged (skippedStrongPresence >= 1 or stage disqualified)

valid_cases.scenario: Post-demo stage push Completed / Rescheduled / Cancelled
expectations: Lead stage updates to chosen post-demo outcome
HubSpot push detail notes English CRM language

valid_cases.scenario: Generate Gmail cold sequence (max 3) then approve and mark sent
expectations: Sequence has exactly 3 email steps and ~1 week waits (no linkedin_* steps)
Opportunity angles non-empty; drafts personalized from HubSpot note background
After approve+mark_sent step status sent and lead stage contacted
Live Cowork send path is Gmail after approve (UI mark_sent is simulator)

valid_cases.scenario: Remember Floor feedback and apply on next HubSpot sync
valid_cases.request: POST /api/feedback { action: remember, category: company, text: Skip company Peeters Accountants } then POST /api/hubspot sync
expectations: Feedback entry persisted with category, text, timestamp, source, active=true
Sync response includes feedbackSkipped containing Peeters Accountants
Skipped firm stage disqualified or omitted from active upserted set
Governance note still draft → approve → mark sent

valid_cases.scenario: Disable feedback so later runs ignore it
valid_cases.request: POST /api/feedback { action: disable, id } then list
expectations: applyFeedbackToLeads no longer skips that company

valid_cases.scenario: Vacancy HubSpot note drafts one coherent hiring-brand story (no content-calendar pivot)
valid_cases.request: POST /api/sequences generate for lead with open-vacancies CRM note
expectations: Email 1 opens from vacancy/quiet LinkedIn insight
One tension about hiring visibility / trust — same story
Soft Willow bridge continues hiring/visibility thread
Body must NOT mention content calendar / quarterly calendar as a random pivot
Emails 2–3 continue same story; Email 1 CTA is soft (curious/chat), not feature dump
Senior peer-to-peer tone (not junior AI pitch)

valid_cases.scenario: Reply→demo BOOK NOW: classify real intent, offer 2 Ludwig slots, Slack Floor
valid_cases.request: Cowork skill sales-reply-demo on inbound Gmail ‘Can we book 30 min next week?’ from Dutch batch lead
expectations: Short outbound reply offers exactly 2 concrete Ludwig demo slots (calendar or edit-ready placeholders)
Slack Floor includes full thread + classification + slots
E2/E3 cancelled; HubSpot logs inbound + outbound

valid_cases.scenario: Multi-batch HubSpot pull: 30-day lookback, never-contacted only, re-run same day
valid_cases.request: Cowork skill sales-hubspot-pull / sales-lead-run: second Dutch batch same day after one batch already ran
expectations: Pulls Dutch HubSpot tasks from last ~30 days (not today-only)
Skips contacts/companies with prior outbound email or logged HubSpot outreach
Skips anyone already in today’s earlier approve/sent queues
Produces a new approve-queue chunk (default up to 50)
Does not treat prior run as done forever; offers another batch / next scheduled slot

invalid_cases.request: POST /api/bookings { leadId: lead_1, aeName: Fake Person, scheduledAt: future ISO }
POST /api/bookings { leadId: lead_1, aeName: Sarah Chen, scheduledAt: future ISO, durationMinutes: 5 }

invalid_cases.scenario: Import commit without selected rows (no silent blast)
Sequence mark_sent before approve (no silent send)
invalid_cases.request: POST /api/sequences { action: mark_sent, sequenceId, stepId } on draft step

invalid_cases.scenario: Generate sequence for disqualified / strong-presence lead

invalid_cases.request: Active never_pitch feedback + POST sequences mark_sent on draft step
expectations: Feedback applied to drafts only — no auto-send

invalid_cases.scenario: Politeness / ‘sounds interesting’ must not be BOOK NOW or auto-book
invalid_cases.request: Cowork skill sales-reply-demo on inbound ‘Sounds interesting, thanks!’ with no ask for a call
expectations: Classification is NOT YET (or CONFUSED if they missed the point) — never BOOK NOW
No Ludwig slot offer as a hard book ask

invalid_cases.scenario: Must not draft outreach to already-contacted HubSpot lead
invalid_cases.request: Cowork skill sales-hubspot-pull on Dutch task whose contact has prior outbound email engagement
expectations: Skip reason already contacted / prior outreach
No approve-queue item created for that lead
